evals.prompt: 从旧 tickets=true, dag=true 的 active attempt 恢复执行。state 中 T1 DONE、T2 PENDING，Ticket 仍 PENDING。
evals.expected_output: Validates the legacy state, opens progress.md, selects the next released unit, and does not accept a Ticket from Task completion alone.
expectations: Uses Progress active checkpoint and canonical dependencies
Keeps legacy Task and Ticket axes separate
Uses CAS state updates and repository-relative evidence

evals.prompt: 验证完成，准备写 pass Gate；comparison point 是当前 Git commit。
evals.expected_output: Closes review/manual acceptance/findings, performs Stage 7, audits the completion claim, and writes the current readable Gate only when evidence supports pass.
expectations: Requires comparison commit to equal current Git HEAD
Requires durable delta or an explicit no-durable-delta reason
Clears active checkpoints and freezes the current Attempt after terminal Gate

evals.prompt: 一个没有 DAG 的 long-running attempt 收到 dispatch 的 Outcome: INCOMPLETE；主 session 需要恢复。
evals.expected_output: Consumes the dispatch recovery facts and writes an active checkpoint before any fresh continuation.
expectations: Does not reinterpret INCOMPLETE as DONE
Uses state.activeCheckpoints because no DAG Task exists
Records the returned recovery facts and next action

evals.prompt: finding closure 已有中间证据，但 do-review 的 terminal-final report 表明 coverage incomplete。可以写 terminal pass 吗？
evals.expected_output: Consumes the owning review report and blocks terminal pass until terminal-final coverage is complete and blocking findings are closed.
expectations: Does not reconstruct reviewer topology
Requires complete terminal-final coverage
Requires blocking findings closed

evals.prompt: terminal-final 中一个跨轨 candidate 被 parent 接受并归类为 Track C finding；现有 Spec/contract 已唯一规定 expected behavior。现在准备派发修复。
evals.expected_output: Consumes one fresh independent source recheck from the same ReviewRun, cites the current design sources, and then treats the finding as an implementation or evidence defect.
expectations: Triggers only after parent acceptance and Track C classification
Requires one finding-scoped independent source recheck before fix dispatch
Does not create a Ticket/Attempt state or replace closure/terminal review

evals.prompt: Track A 报告一个实现错误，parent 已接受；没有把它归类为 Track C。
evals.expected_output: Routes the accepted implementation finding normally without starting a design-source recheck.
expectations: Does not trigger the source recheck
Does not infer Track C from generic review wording
Keeps normal implementation and closure routing

evals.prompt: parent 接受并归类 Track C finding；独立 source recheck 发现 Decision、Spec 与 contract-design 对恢复行为互相冲突。
evals.expected_output: Stops fix dispatch and routes the exact source conflict to req-align; if multiple product outcomes remain, requests the owner decision.
expectations: Does not patch implementation against conflicting sources
Routes contract revision to req-align
Does not add a review phase or runtime state
